entries.task: Find planted bugs: 105 across two repositories, count fixed
entries.samples: 3 runs per effort, current rows; each run covers both repositories
entries.metric: planted bugs fixed, mean of 3, out of 105
entries.timeDefinition: wall clock summed over both repositories; the board says its machines were shared with other work for some rows, so times compare loosely at best
entries.costDefinition: list-rate API price estimated from usage counts, summed over both repositories; not an invoice or subscription billing
entries.limitations: Counts planted bugs, not review quality on real changes; repeated attempts are not independent replications; runs used a 1M context window, and the board says its older Opus 5 rows are not comparable to these; the board also lists low and max rungs that this entry leaves out
entries.rationale: xhigh fixed the most (36 of 105); medium fixed 5.7 fewer for 55% less cost and 60% less time. A lower effort supports a balanced starting point, not equivalence

entries.task: Find planted bugs: 105 across two repositories, count fixed
entries.route: Meta API through a Muse Code subscription plan; no per-use price
entries.samples: 2 runs per effort, current rows; each run covers both repositories
entries.metric: planted bugs fixed, mean of 2, out of 105
entries.timeDefinition: active wall clock summed over both repositories; the board says its machine was shared with other work, and some runs were resumed in segments, so only active time is counted
entries.costDefinition: unknown: Meta publishes no price for this model, so no dollar figure is recorded
entries.limitations: Few runs per effort, and the board measures a median run-to-run move of about a point and a half on three-run configurations, so a gap of that size between efforts is not a difference; the board lists no high or lower rung; reachable only through a Muse Code subscription plan, so it fits a user who already has one; its usage draws on that plan's rolling windows, which the board does not measure
entries.rationale: max fixed 42 and xhigh 41.5 of 105, a gap within the board's run-to-run spread, so the efforts are not distinguishable on fixed bugs. Suggest it as an additional seat from a different model family where the user has a Muse Code plan and allows the effort; start at xhigh, and use max only on request
